input_resources: orders(query, sortKey: UPDATED_AT) with lineItems, transactions, fulfillments, refunds, returns
identity_rule: provider identity scoped by connection/account namespace: dedup_key = <namespace>:<provider event id>; entity refs are tenant-scoped; no join by email or bare order number
coverage_rule: coverage.observed per capability after a fully paginated/imported run; answers compare required datasets against coverage facts and return partial/insufficient_data otherwise

retention.basis: merchant-owned data under the Shopify Partner Program Agreement for a merchant-installed custom app; raw payloads are not retained, only typed observations

event_rules.rule: crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: shipment.observed -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: shipment.dispatched -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: shipment.delivered -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: shipment.cancelled -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

synchronization.initial_import: plan-driven fixed UTC window, cursor pagination, per-page durable commit (shopify); single envelope/import (generic, bank_csv); on-write (policy, runtime, replay)
synchronization.reconciliation: daily reconciliation of the last 48 h for polling capabilities; re-import for files; n/a for internal producers
synchronization.deduplication: journal_append rejects identical provider identity (inserted=false) and raises BBX02 for different content (review case)
synchronization.freshness: last_successful_sync_at (complete empty checks allowed) distinct from last_new_record_at; delayed after 3x poll interval

local_standalone.schedule: default 5 min incremental over updated_at with 10 min overlap (stock 15 min); daily reconciliation of the last 48 h; adjustable 1–60 min; Retry-After and cost throttle honoured
local_standalone.history_limit: orders older than 60 days need read_all_orders; otherwise the accessible period is disclosed in coverage
local_standalone.authentication: custom-app Admin API token stored AES-256-GCM encrypted
local_standalone.recovery: durable per-page commit before checkpoint advance; restart resumes cursors; duplicates deduplicated by provider identity
local_standalone.limitations: no webhooks (outbound only); intermediate provider states between polls are not observed

local_gateway.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no gateway is provisioned in the pilot)

public_server.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no public server profile in the pilot)

import_readiness.time_selection: import plan presets resolve once to a fixed UTC interval in the workspace timezone (packages/application/src/sources/import-plan.ts); orders select on updated_at
import_readiness.historical_availability: requested versus accessible period recorded in capability coverage; 60-day limit disclosed when read_all_orders is missing
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: orders carry transactions, fulfillments, refunds and returns inline, so related records arrive with their parent; older open orders are included by the plan flag
import_readiness.opening_state: inventory levels are snapshots (snapshot_only basis provider_available), never movements
import_readiness.progress_accounting: import runs count pages, orders fetched, observations committed, duplicates and conflicts; totals are unknown (counts only, no percentage)
import_readiness.readiness_rules: coverage.observed per capability after a fully paginated run; queries report partial until present
import_readiness.health_rules: last_successful_sync_at advances on complete successful runs only; last_new_record_at only when new observations commit; delayed after 3x the poll interval
import_readiness.history_expansion: a new plan revision enqueues a history_expansion run with overlap and deduplication
import_readiness.data_handling: customer ids are opaque provider ids; no names/emails enter the journal; token encrypted at rest
